scenes.headline: How replaying the router steadies MoE training
scenes.sub: Rollout Routing Replay, from a Peking University and Xiaomi team.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Ramen! Reinforcement learning on mixture-of-experts models tends to blow up. Rollout Routing Replay finds the cause, and fixes it with one idea.

scenes.text: The router picks different experts when a rollout is generated than when it is scored. So record the rollout's choice, and replay it in training.
scenes.say: The router picks different experts when a rollout is generated than when it's scored. So record the rollout's choice, and replay it in training.

steps.say: Training runs two engines. A fast inference engine, SGLang, samples the answers.
A training engine, Megatron, rescores them. Same math, different arithmetic.
The ratio of their probabilities scales each update. When the engines agree, it sits near one.

steps.note: About 10% of routers pick a different expert
steps.say: But in a mixture-of-experts layer, a tiny difference flips which experts the router keeps. The ratio jumps, and the run collapses.

scenes.title: The one term R3 changes
scenes.say: Gate weights are a softmax over the experts the mask keeps. R3 swaps one term.

parts.note: the top-K mask captured at rollout, borrowed
parts.say: The mask comes from the rollout, so training uses exactly the rollout's experts.

parts.note: the training logits, so the router still gets gradient
parts.say: The softmax still runs on training logits, so the router keeps learning.

steps.say: During rollout, record each token's mask at every layer. Multi-turn agents cache the masks next to the KV cache.
Both training passes, recompute and update, replay those masks instead of choosing their own experts.
GSPO's earlier replay started at recompute. Starting at the rollout also closes the gap between engines.

scenes.title: Train vs inference KL, in thousandths
scenes.say: Measured as KL: one point five four without it, zero point seven five with R3, near the dense model's zero point six four.

scenes.text: Don't let training re-decide what the rollout already decided: borrow the routing choice, keep the router's gradient.

recap: Two engines route tokens to different experts
R3 replays the rollout's routing mask
The router still trains on its own logits
scenes.say: To recap: the engines disagree about experts, R3 replays the rollout's choice, and the router still learns.
